contract.coldDefinition: Each cold startup row uses a fresh owned Chrome profile and exactly one backend. Backend launch order and count order rotate across repeats. The main render matrix uses one compiled-module page and is labeled warm-compiled-matrix.
contract.startupBoundaries: WASM fetch+ArrayBuffer and compile are separate. actorInitMs combines Worker creation, module instantiation and nativeInit because the public actor handshake intentionally exposes one ownership boundary. Configuration and prepare are separate.
contract.completionMetrics: JavaScript sync timings are scene build plus renderer submission. Rust timings are asynchronous Worker packet RPC, owned decode and renderer submission. Neither is display/compositor FPS.
contract.inputMetric: Pointer event dispatch to library aster:render event. It includes scheduling and backend work, not physical display latency.
contract.memoryLimits: No forced GC, process RSS, Worker-exclusive JS heap, or per-candidate actor memory. Page-wide performance.memory is reported only when available.
contract.environmentLimits: The harness owns isolated Chrome profiles but does not control OS scheduling or unrelated host background load.
contract.scope: SDK pipeline workload with seeded OHLCV, three indicators and six series. It is not a full main-demo navigation or physical display measurement.
contract.order: Cold count/backend launch order and warm count/backend construction/renderer order rotate across repeats.
